faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Who are the best interior designers for homes in Karnal?

The right designer has finished projects you can check, explains costs clearly and supervises work on site. We share past work and our process at the first meeting.

Do you design kothis and independent homes?

Yes. Most Karnal homes are independent houses, and we design full homes including living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, puja rooms and terraces.

Can you work with local contractors and carpenters?

Yes. We provide detailed drawings and supervise the work, whether the execution is by our team or by your trusted local contractors.

What do the best interior designers do differently?

They plan every detail before work starts and stay involved on site, so the finished home matches the design you approved.
